After squirrelling away behind the scenes, I'm SO excited to finally share that the Canva Small Business Pitch Challenge 2026 for the UK & Ireland is officially open 🚀

This has been a real labour of love - working with the team backing this idea, an incredible group of partners, judges and supporters to create something that genuinely aims to help amplify small businesses across the UK and Ireland.

Community is at the heart of Canva, and we know how hard it can be to get your idea noticed. That's why we're giving founders the chance to pitch for funding, mentorship and national exposure through Canva.

If you're building something exciting - whether it's a side hustle, a new venture, or an established business ready for its next chapter - please apply and/or share with your network

🏆 Every entry receives:
3 months of Canva Pro
Exclusive online founder sessions
Practical tools to help tell your business story

🏆 Top 100 businesses receive:
Recognition as one of Canva's Top 100 Small Businesses
An exclusive founder networking event
Opportunities to connect with fellow entrepreneurs

🏆 Top 5 businesses win:
A £4,000 business grant
Their own showcase event at Canva UK HQ
National exposure across Canva channels

Applications are open now ~> https://lnkd.in/e-wmftAN

*Ts&Cs apply - find them on our website.
